direct.units: logit contribution at the decision position: exact removal from the final residual (primary) and with the final-norm scale frozen

total.rule: suppresses (pre-registered): switching the neuron off raises the token by >= 0.1 nats on average and on >= 75% of prefixes
total.conditional_rule: conditional_suppresses (exploratory): the same thresholds for log P(t | first token is not r)
total.note: Set E is a single prefix, so its share is 0% or 100%.
